issues.issue: The statement counts the Garbage department in Public works (p5 General Fund Public works 94,643 = Garbage 94,643), and the statement line is recorded as streets/highways. The detail line uses utilities, so the detail function split does not tie to the statement's function. utilities (refuse) is defensible, but the two levels disagree.
Public works = Street Fund 191,972 + General Fund Garbage department 94,643 (refuse collection contract, p16). A third of it is refuse, so streets/highways is a judgment call.
Utility cost-type line kept in other. There is no exact cost-type match (fuel/repairs mix), so this is defensible, but it is a judgment call.
The page prints only 'Intergovernmental'. Highway allocation is assumed from the Street Fund, and nothing on the page says so.
